subject: design/init-hardening-v1
statement: The hosted workflow's class-policy entry becomes **knob-conditional**: the desired set converge computes includes the workflow exactly when `ci_mode` includes hosted CI. Excluded means **unlisted** — and converge never acts on unlisted paths (the never-touch complement property), so no deletion machinery exists anywhere (`#D-4`; O-2 of the record). Fresh installs are born right; an already-installed repo carrying the workflow under `ci_mode=local` gets a **doctor advisory** naming the mismatch and both remedies (flip the knob · delete the file). Desk hooks install in every mode (the hard-dependency ruling, `brainstorm:installer#D-6`).
